Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in while turning left in Houston. Is it all right if we proceed?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe what happened, in your own words.
A: I was driving through an intersection and wanted to turn left onto the cross street. There was a gap in oncoming
traffic, so I started the turn. A vehicle coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your turn?
A: I saw it, but it looked like it was still a good distance away. I judged that I had time to make the turn.
Q: Was the signal in your favor when you entered the intersection?
A: I believe it had just turned yellow. I was going to make the turn on the arrow, but the arrow had already ended by
then.
Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?
A: I had some neck stiffness right away, but I didn't think much of it. By the next morning the pain had gotten worse,
and I had trouble turning my head to the side.
Q: Have you seen a doctor snice the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic two days later. They diagnosed whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some
medication. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. Sitting for long periods makes it worse, and I get headaches at the back of my head most afternoons.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send over the medical bills and the repair estimate when I have them.
Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
